messages:
maya (billing): follow-up from the postmortem: yesterday's delayed batch commits caused several invoices to under-report tokens. we need owners for: customer credits, a ledger backfill run, a permanent detection rule, and a comms plan.
liam (eng-infra): i'll take the detection + dashboard + alerting hook. will push a small metric change that emits event to #metering-alerts. ETA tomorrow mid-day.
arjun (finance): i'll own ledger backfill and invoice corrections. priya on ops? we may need a maintenance window for backfill.
priya (finance-ops): i can coordinate the backfill window with AR. prefer low-traffic hours. estimate 4h run for the affected shard.
maya (billing): attaching quick extract of affected windows (prelim):
```csv
customer,window,approx_missing_tokens
cust_88,2026-03-22T02:00Z-02:45Z,420
cust_12,2026-03-22T02:10Z-02:50Z,1180
```
jordan (eng-sre): root cause: consumer v3 batching got stuck on a DB lock during commit, causing delayed acknowledgement and token attribution later -> appeared as undercount. adding idempotent commit + lock timeout. PR tomorrow.
sophia (customer-success): i'll prep two versions of comms: short credit notice and detailed explanation for accounts that ask. can we standardize the credit label on invoices? customers ask what an "adjustment" line means.
arjun (finance): yes. suggestion: invoice line "System Adjustment (token undercount)" with token delta and USD credit. priya, is that ok for AR?
priya (finance-ops): yes, works. we'll need a CSV per account with token_delta, USD_amount, invoice_id. arjun i'll need the format.
liam (eng-infra): detection rule plan: signal when "batch_commit_delay_ms > 60000 and missing_token_estimate > 200". will also emit an automated ticket MET-4499 to queue.
maya (billing): rounding policy proposal: credit to nearest 25 tokens for <$1k/mo accounts, nearest 250 for >$1k/mo. keeping smaller granularity avoids chasing tiny cents.
arjun (finance): agree. I'll also flag any per-contract exceptions.
jordan (eng-sre): additional: we'll add a daily job to surface recurring patterns (customer-level) so we catch persistent regressions. ETA 5d.
sophia (customer-success): for comms, i'll include FAQ: "how long until credit appears" and "why it happened". will draft and share in 12h.
maya (billing): action summary: liam -> detection + MET-4499 (tomorrow); jordan -> PR for idempotent commits (PR in 24h, rollout 48h); arjun + priya -> ledger backfill & invoice corrections (prep CSV 24h, run during 4h window next week); sophia -> comms draft in 12h.
billing-bot: Ticket MET-4499 created: "ingest_batch_commit_delay -> metering undercount" assigned to eng-infra.
arjun (finance): one more ask: please tag customers that need manual sign-off before applying credits (contractual). i'll filter those out of the auto-run.
maya (billing): noted. i'll add a column in the runbook for "requires_approval".
liam (eng-infra): i'll add a histogram metric "batch_commit_latency_p50/95/99" and a boolean tag when lock failures > 0.
sophia (customer-success): thanks team. i'll queue outreach for the two affected customers in the CSV and hold until we confirm credit amounts.
maya (billing): thanks all. i'll keep the follow-up doc updated and schedule a 48h check-in. :white_check_mark:
